name: How quickly do I need to begin property restoration after storm damage?

mainEntity.name: How quickly do I need to begin property restoration after storm damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners should start property restoration as soon as the source of damage is secured and the property is safe to enter. Delaying repairs after storm damage or moisture intrusion can lead to secondary problems, including subfloor rot, warped framing, and mold growth behind drywall. When preparing for restoration work, thoroughly document all damage with clear photos and notes before any materials are removed. If you are dealing with an insurance claim or foreclosed property rehab, having detailed records of damaged trim, drywall, flooring, and framing helps ensure your repair estimates accurately capture the full scope of structural and finish repairs required.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin restoration immediately once the site is safe. Prompt repairs stop framing rot and secondary damage, while early photo documentation supports accurate repair estimates.
